summary: Off-highway vehicle carrying two adults and four children rolled ~300 ft down an embankment in San Juan County around 4:15 p.m.; one victim flown out by Flight for Life, four transported by ambulance.
location: San Juan County (embankment off OHV trail)
responding_agency: San Juan County Search and Rescue; San Juan County Sheriff; Silverton Ambulance; San Juan County Fire; Durango Fire; Flight for Life
notes: SJC SAR reported all children wore safety gear.
